title: mentha × dumetorum var. hirta
intro: Mentha × dumetorum var. hirta, commonly known as a variety of wild mint, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and improve respiratory function. Its bioactive constituents, including menthone, menthol, and limonene, are responsible for its pharmacological activities, making it a subject of interest for further research.
